svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

This class is the foundation exception descriptor for MIPI LANE transactions.

It is intended to be used by exception list and it can be base class for the users who need to provide specific error values through tests. The exceptions are errors that may be introduced into transactions, for the purpose of testing how the connected port of a DUT responds. The ultimate goal of this class is to describe an error on a MIPI LANE transaction in the following terms:

  • Which MIPI LANE is affected.
  • Which fields of MIPI LANE Transaction is(are) affected.

    This class contains all types of error flags and fields required for adding exceptions, which are injected in the MIPI LANE.

    To accomplish this, a top-down abstraction-driven approach is used to define the error. The error definition is based on the idea that errors may be classified based on the field affected or mechanism required for response /behaviour. This class defines basic errors which will affect the lane layer. The types of errors are listed in lane_transaction_error_enum.

    When an object of this class is randomized, the error type out of lane_transaction_error_enum is selected first. Then if applicable, the corresponding error value is generated (based on constraints). Once these selections have been made, this class has built-in constraints to cause a randomized object of this type to select valid error kinds, values given a known configuration and transaction.

    The instance of this class is used in exception list class. In turn, the instance of exception list shall be inside the lane transaction/ sequence item. The exception list shall receive randomized exceptions from this class.

  • Once the affected field or type of error are selected through the built-in constraints, the default (i.e. built-in) error injection mechanisms will be applied to the lane transaction.

    Error Injection

    If the particular error flag is set then the corresponding error shall be injected. this means When an error is defined, it must then be injected into a transaction based on the available transaction. In the VIP there are two mechanisms that make this happen, as described below.

    Transaction Object Error Injection - using methods in transactor

    For errors that do not require special handling, injection occurs by protocol driver/receiver modifying the contents of the transaction object itself. The VIP transactor then executes the transaction as it normally would, based on the contents of the transaction object. All errors possible are supported this way. However, for several special cases, the VIP transactor must interpret and apply the error. Those situations are described in the following section.

    Transactor Supported Error Injection - using special mechanism

    Some error types require special handling by the VIP transactors, because they cannot be expressed directly in the transaction object. In these cases, the transaction object is not modified, but the transaction, as executed by the VIP transactor. IMPORTANT It is important that the impact of the defined solving order is understood. The solve_order constraint block in this class specifies that the randomized variables be solved in the specific order

 (  string prop_name , bit [1023:0] prop_val , ref string prop_val_string , input svt_pattern_data :: type_enum typ  )

 svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::do_is_valid

Enum declaration for injecting various Lane Transaction errors. Refer Section 6.2 of DPHY specification - version 1.00.00
ERR_SOT_HS( `SVT_MIPI_LANE_ERR_SOT_HS )
High Speed Recoverable SOT Error.
ERR_NONE( `SVT_MIPI_LANE_ERR_NONE )
No error injected.
ERR_SOT_SYNC_HS( `SVT_MIPI_LANE_ERR_SOT_SYNC_HS )
High Speed Non-Recoverable SOT Error.
ERR_EOT_SYNC( `SVT_MIPI_LANE_ERR_EOT_SYNC )
Inject EOT Sync error.
ERR_ESC_MODE_ENTRY_CMD( `SVT_MIPI_LANE_ERR_ESC_MODE_ENTRY_CMD )
Inject error in ESC mode entry CMD.
ERR_LP_TRANSMISSION_SYNC( `SVT_MIPI_LANE_ERR_LP_TRANSMISSION_SYNC )
Inject error in LP transamission. The data is not synchronized to byte boundary at the end of low power transmission.
ERR_FALSE_CONTROL( `SVT_MIPI_LANE_ERR_FALSE_CONTROL )
Inject false control error in specific transmission modes.
ERR_LP0_CONTENTION( `SVT_MIPI_LANE_ERR_LP0_CONTENTION )
Inject lp0 contention error by driving dp dn as 1 1 from Host when Device is also driving something.Dphy Spec 1.0 Section 6.1.

Inject lp1 contention error with dp dn as 0 0 from Host when Device is also driving something.Dphy Spec 1.0 Section 6.1.

Inject invalid state lp11 error on clock lane.

High Speed alternate sync SOT error.
ERR_ALTERNATE_CAL_PATTERN_HS( `SVT_MIPI_LANE_ERR_ALTERNATE_CAL_PATTERN_HS )
High Speed ALTERNATE calibration pattern error.

High Speed ALTERNATE calibration sequence drop error.

  constraint
 svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::reasonable_data_word_count

constraint reasonable_data_word_count {
    data_word_count inside {[1:20]};
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::reasonable_err_esc_mode_entry_cmd_value

Reasonable constraint for Escape mode entry command error injecting reserved values.
constraint reasonable_err_esc_mode_entry_cmd_value {
    if(lane_transaction_error == ERR_ESC_MODE_ENTRY_CMD)
      {
         !(err_esc_mode_entry_cmd_value inside {8'h87,8'h78,8'h46,8'hBA,8'h84,8'h05});
      }
      else
      {
         err_esc_mode_entry_cmd_value == 0;
      }
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::reasonable_err_hs_trail_value

Reasonable constraint for HS Trail error in ns.
constraint reasonable_err_hs_trail_value {
    err_hs_trail_value >= 1 && err_hs_trail_value < 5;
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::reasonable_err_lp_contention

Reasonable constraint for start time & period for lp contention.
constraint reasonable_err_lp_contention {
      if(lane_transaction_error == ERR_LP1_CONTENTION || lane_transaction_error == ERR_LP0_CONTENTION)
      {
         lp_contention_start_time inside { [ (20*): (200*)] };
         lp_contention_period inside { [ (500*): (1000*)] };
      }
      else
      {
         lp_contention_start_time == 0;
         lp_contention_period == 0;
      }
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::reasonable_err_sot_hs_value

Reasonable constraint for Single bit error in SOT HS SYNC pattern to recover.
constraint reasonable_err_sot_hs_value {
    if(lane_transaction_error == ERR_SOT_HS)
      {
         err_sot_hs_value[1:0] == 2'b00;
         err_sot_hs_value[7] + err_sot_hs_value[6] +
         err_sot_hs_value[5] + err_sot_hs_value[4] + err_sot_hs_value[3] + err_sot_hs_value[2] == 1;
      }
      else
      {
         err_sot_hs_value == 0;
      }
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::reasonable_err_sot_sync_hs_value

Reasonable constraint for Multi bit error in SOT HS SYNC pattern. Sync pattern won't be detected.
constraint reasonable_err_sot_sync_hs_value {
    if(lane_transaction_error == ERR_SOT_SYNC_HS)
      {
         err_sot_sync_hs_value[2:0] == 3'b001;
         err_sot_sync_hs_value[7] +
         err_sot_sync_hs_value[6] +
         err_sot_sync_hs_value[5] +
         err_sot_sync_hs_value[4] +
         err_sot_sync_hs_value[3] >= 1;
      }
      else
      {
         err_sot_sync_hs_value == 0;
      }
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::reasonable_invalid_state_period_after_hs_trail

Reasonable constraint for Period of invalid state after HS Trail in terms of UI.
constraint reasonable_invalid_state_period_after_hs_trail {
    invalid_state_period_after_hs_trail >= 8 && invalid_state_period_after_hs_trail <= 100;
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::valid_ranges

constraint for valid range.
constraint valid_ranges {
    err_esc_mode_entry_cmd_value inside { [8'h0:8'hFF] };
     err_eot_sync_value inside {[1 : 7]};
     if(cfg.dphy_protocol_version >= svt_mipi_lane_configuration::DPHY_VERSION_21)
    {
      lane_transaction_error inside {ERR_SOT_HS, ERR_SOT_SYNC_HS, ERR_EOT_SYNC, ERR_ESC_MODE_ENTRY_CMD, ERR_LP_TRANSMISSION_SYNC, ERR_FALSE_CONTROL, ERR_LP0_CONTENTION, ERR_LP1_CONTENTION, ERR_DATA_INVALID_STATE, ERR_CLK_LANE_INVALID_STATE, ERR_HS_TRAIL, ERR_BTA_TA_TIMER_TIMEOUT, ERR_NONE, ERR_SKEW_SYNC_HS, ERR_INITIAL_SKEW_PATTERN_HS, ERR_PERIODIC_SKEW_PATTERN_HS, ERR_DEASSERT_TX_REQUEST_HS_WHEN_TX_READY_HS_REMAINS_LOW_AT_START_OF_HS_TRANSMISSION,ERR_ASSERT_TX_REQUEST_HS_AND_TX_REQUEST_ESC_SIMULTANEOUSLY,ERR_TX_RQST_ASSERTED_WITH_TRIGGER_ULPS_LPDT_ESC_DEASSERTED,ERR_TX_RQST_ESC_AND_TX_RQST_HS_BOTH_ASSERTED,ERR_MORE_THAN_ONE_RX_LPDT_ESC_AND_RX_ULPS_ESC_AND_RX_TRIGGER_HIGH,ERR_DIRECTION_1_TX_REQUEST,ERR_ENABLE_DEASSERTION_DURING_HS_TRANSMISSION,ERR_X_OR_Z_ON_SIGNAL,ERR_RX_DATA_WIDTH_HS_VALUE,ERR_RX_DATA_WIDTH_HS_RESERVED_VALUE_11,ERR_RX_DATA_WIDTH_HS_RUNTIME_VALUE,ERR_RESERVED_VALUE_IN_TX_DATA_WIDTH_HS,ERR_NON_REQUIRED_VALUE_OF_TX_DATA_HS,ERR_TX_DATA_WIDTH_HS_RUNTIME_VALUE,ERR_NON_REQUIRED_VALUE_OF_TX_VALID_HS,ERR_IN_TXVALIDHS_VS_TXREQUESTHS,ERR_TX_REQUEST_ESC_VS_TX_VALID_ESC,ERR_LP_NO_SPACE_STATE_IN_BYTE,ERR_FLIPPED_BITS_IN_PREAMBLE,ERR_FLIPPED_BITS_IN_EXTENDED_SYNC,ERR_ALTERNATE_SYNC_HS,ERR_ALTERNATE_CAL_PATTERN_HS,ERR_DROP_ALTERNATE_CAL,ERR_BACK_TO_BACK_ESC_ENTRY_PROCEDURE,ERR_DRIVE_SYNC_ON_NEGEDGE,ERR_DRIVE_PREAMBLE_FOR_DATA_RATES_BELOW_2_5_GBPS,ERR_INSERT_PACKET_BW_INITIAL_SKEW_AND_ALTERNATE_CALIBRATION,ERR_BYPASS_STOPSTATE_WAIT};
    }
    else if(cfg.dphy_protocol_version == svt_mipi_lane_configuration::DPHY_VERSION_20)
    {
      lane_transaction_error inside {ERR_SOT_HS, ERR_SOT_SYNC_HS, ERR_EOT_SYNC, ERR_ESC_MODE_ENTRY_CMD, ERR_LP_TRANSMISSION_SYNC, ERR_FALSE_CONTROL, ERR_LP0_CONTENTION, ERR_LP1_CONTENTION, ERR_DATA_INVALID_STATE, ERR_CLK_LANE_INVALID_STATE, ERR_HS_TRAIL, ERR_BTA_TA_TIMER_TIMEOUT, ERR_NONE, ERR_SKEW_SYNC_HS, ERR_INITIAL_SKEW_PATTERN_HS, ERR_PERIODIC_SKEW_PATTERN_HS, ERR_DEASSERT_TX_REQUEST_HS_WHEN_TX_READY_HS_REMAINS_LOW_AT_START_OF_HS_TRANSMISSION,ERR_ASSERT_TX_REQUEST_HS_AND_TX_REQUEST_ESC_SIMULTANEOUSLY,ERR_TX_RQST_ASSERTED_WITH_TRIGGER_ULPS_LPDT_ESC_DEASSERTED,ERR_TX_RQST_ESC_AND_TX_RQST_HS_BOTH_ASSERTED,ERR_MORE_THAN_ONE_RX_LPDT_ESC_AND_RX_ULPS_ESC_AND_RX_TRIGGER_HIGH,ERR_DIRECTION_1_TX_REQUEST,ERR_ENABLE_DEASSERTION_DURING_HS_TRANSMISSION,ERR_X_OR_Z_ON_SIGNAL,ERR_RX_DATA_WIDTH_HS_VALUE,ERR_RX_DATA_WIDTH_HS_RESERVED_VALUE_11,ERR_RX_DATA_WIDTH_HS_RUNTIME_VALUE,ERR_RESERVED_VALUE_IN_TX_DATA_WIDTH_HS,ERR_NON_REQUIRED_VALUE_OF_TX_DATA_HS,ERR_TX_DATA_WIDTH_HS_RUNTIME_VALUE,ERR_NON_REQUIRED_VALUE_OF_TX_VALID_HS,ERR_IN_TXVALIDHS_VS_TXREQUESTHS,ERR_TX_REQUEST_ESC_VS_TX_VALID_ESC,ERR_LP_NO_SPACE_STATE_IN_BYTE,ERR_BACK_TO_BACK_ESC_ENTRY_PROCEDURE,ERR_DRIVE_SYNC_ON_NEGEDGE,ERR_BYPASS_STOPSTATE_WAIT};
    }
    else if(cfg.dphy_protocol_version >= svt_mipi_lane_configuration::DPHY_VERSION_12)
    {
      lane_transaction_error inside {ERR_SOT_HS, ERR_SOT_SYNC_HS, ERR_EOT_SYNC, ERR_ESC_MODE_ENTRY_CMD, ERR_LP_TRANSMISSION_SYNC, ERR_FALSE_CONTROL, ERR_LP0_CONTENTION, ERR_LP1_CONTENTION, ERR_DATA_INVALID_STATE, ERR_CLK_LANE_INVALID_STATE, ERR_HS_TRAIL, ERR_BTA_TA_TIMER_TIMEOUT, ERR_NONE, ERR_SKEW_SYNC_HS, ERR_INITIAL_SKEW_PATTERN_HS, ERR_PERIODIC_SKEW_PATTERN_HS, ERR_DEASSERT_TX_REQUEST_HS_WHEN_TX_READY_HS_REMAINS_LOW_AT_START_OF_HS_TRANSMISSION,ERR_ASSERT_TX_REQUEST_HS_AND_TX_REQUEST_ESC_SIMULTANEOUSLY,ERR_TX_RQST_ASSERTED_WITH_TRIGGER_ULPS_LPDT_ESC_DEASSERTED,ERR_TX_RQST_ESC_AND_TX_RQST_HS_BOTH_ASSERTED,ERR_MORE_THAN_ONE_RX_LPDT_ESC_AND_RX_ULPS_ESC_AND_RX_TRIGGER_HIGH,ERR_DIRECTION_1_TX_REQUEST,ERR_ENABLE_DEASSERTION_DURING_HS_TRANSMISSION,ERR_X_OR_Z_ON_SIGNAL,ERR_TX_REQUEST_ESC_VS_TX_VALID_ESC,ERR_LP_NO_SPACE_STATE_IN_BYTE,ERR_BACK_TO_BACK_ESC_ENTRY_PROCEDURE,ERR_DRIVE_SYNC_ON_NEGEDGE,ERR_BYPASS_STOPSTATE_WAIT};
    }
    else
    {
      lane_transaction_error inside {ERR_SOT_HS, ERR_SOT_SYNC_HS, ERR_EOT_SYNC, ERR_ESC_MODE_ENTRY_CMD, ERR_LP_TRANSMISSION_SYNC, ERR_FALSE_CONTROL, ERR_LP0_CONTENTION, ERR_LP1_CONTENTION, ERR_DATA_INVALID_STATE, ERR_CLK_LANE_INVALID_STATE, ERR_HS_TRAIL, ERR_BTA_TA_TIMER_TIMEOUT, ERR_NONE, ERR_LP_NO_SPACE_STATE_IN_BYTE,ERR_BACK_TO_BACK_ESC_ENTRY_PROCEDURE,ERR_DRIVE_SYNC_ON_NEGEDGE,ERR_BYPASS_STOPSTATE_WAIT};
    }
     /** Valid range constraints for error position for insertion of corrupted 8-bits during initial or periodic skew pattern or alternate calibration. */
    if(cfg.dphy_protocol_version >= svt_mipi_lane_configuration::DPHY_VERSION_12)
    {
      err_initial_deskew_position inside {[1 : this.cfg.initial_skew_cal_timer]};
       err_alternate_cal_position inside {[1 : this.cfg.alternate_cal_timer]};
        err_periodic_deskew_position inside {[1 :this.cfg.periodic_skew_cal_timer]};
        err_skew_sync_sot_value != 16'hFFFF;
       err_alternate_sync_sot_value!= 8'hF0;
       err_invalid_periodic_skew_pattern != 8'hAA;
       err_invalid_initial_skew_pattern != 8'hAA;
    }
     err_invalid_hs_trail_bits_pattern.size() == this.cfg.num_err_hs_trailing_bytes;
    foreach(err_invalid_hs_trail_bits_pattern[i])
    {
      err_invalid_hs_trail_bits_pattern[i] inside {[8'h1:8'hFE]};
    }
    /** Valid constraints for Invalid state on Clock lane exception */
    if(cfg.interlane_skew_enable == 1)
    {
      invalid_state_error != CLK_SM_ERR_INVLD_STOP_AFTER_HS_GO;
    }
   }
